title: Friedgut coordinates
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube and a real number $\varepsilon$, define its Friedgut coordinate set to be the set of influential coordinates of $f$ at the threshold supplied by Theorem 9.28 for $f$, $\varepsilon$, and the Friedgut degree of $f$ at $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
caveat: The supplied context does not define the threshold in Theorem 9.28 or the precise meaning of influential coordinates.
